# Yellow Filter
This resource pack simply changes the default lighting color to a yellow one

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FqkgxpuW/images/fe4d3a3d0f09ba76fd3a97fe84fc4b6753e83b41.png)

## Requirement

- The graphic settings need to be set to 'Faboulous'
